query_sql:
SELECT sequence,event_key,account_id,peer_id,namespace,message_id,kind,observed_at,server_edit_at,substr(text,1,2048),author_id,sent_at,entities FROM events INDEXED BY events_message WHERE account_id=? AND peer_id=? AND namespace=?
AND message_id>=? AND message_id<=? AND kind=1 AND sent_at>=? AND sent_at<=? AND observed_at>=?
AND sequence=(SELECT MAX(latest.sequence) FROM events AS latest INDEXED BY events_message
WHERE latest.account_id=events.account_id AND latest.peer_id=events.peer_id
AND latest.namespace=events.namespace AND latest.message_id=events.message_id AND latest.kind=1) AND author_id IS NOT NULL AND author_id NOT IN (?) ORDER BY message_id DESC,sequence DESC LIMIT ?;
